five_caveats_per_raw10: 1) anima/anima-agent/ contains ~60 unique files (dashboard, employee, trading, build, results, .py legacy) NOT in standalone — deletion = data loss
2) .roadmap.anima_agent (active, 2026-05-03) verifier paths point at legacy dir — deletion would orphan SSOT
3) standalone hexa.toml provenance line confirms it was extracted FROM legacy dir, not vice versa
4) zero `import "anima_agent"` consumers in anima codebase — there is nothing to refactor to CLI shellout
5) ~25 in-flight uncommitted modifications (P9, qmirror docs) — even a 'safe' scrub commit risks mixing unrelated work
